diseases.name: Extradural haematoma
diseases.inv: Emergency CT head and neurosurgical review.
diseases.tool: NICE head injury guideline and Canadian CT Head Rule define CT indications in defined adults; apply the full rule.

diseases.name: Subdural haematoma (acute or chronic)
diseases.inv: CT head, coagulation profile, urgent neurosurgical review.

diseases.name: Skull base or depressed skull fracture
diseases.inv: CT head including bone windows; neurosurgical review; watch for CSF leak and meningitis.

diseases.name: Concussion / mild traumatic brain injury
diseases.inv: Neurological observation, CT if criteria met; advice on return-to-activity.

diseases.name: Normal pressure hydrocephalus
diseases.inv: CT/MRI brain showing ventricular enlargement, specialist assessment.

diseases.name: Metabolic or toxic encephalopathy (e.g. hypoglycaemia)
diseases.inv: Immediate glucose, electrolytes, urea, LFTs, blood gas, toxicology.
diseases.alt: Raised ICP, stroke, infection, post-ictal state

diseases.name: Lumbar disc prolapse / radiculopathy
diseases.inv: Clinical; MRI if persistent or red flags.
diseases.alt: Cauda equina syndrome, spinal stenosis, hip pathology

diseases.name: Neural tube defect (spina bifida)
diseases.inv: Urgent neurosurgical and paediatric review; keep sac covered and moist; ultrasound/MRI.

diseases.name: Infant hydrocephalus
diseases.inv: Head circumference chart, cranial ultrasound, urgent neurosurgical review.

diseases.name: Benign familial macrocephaly
diseases.inv: Head circumference trend, parents' head size; ultrasound if doubt.

diseases.name: Spastic gait from cord or brain disease
diseases.inv: Neurological examination, MRI brain and spine, B12.
diseases.alt: Cervical myelopathy, MS, stroke, cord tumour

diseases.name: Cerebellar ataxia
diseases.inv: MRI brain, alcohol history, B12, thyroid, drug review.

diseases.name: Parkinson disease / parkinsonism
diseases.tool: UK Brain Bank / MDS criteria are used by specialists; apply separately.
diseases.alt: Essential tremor, drug-induced parkinsonism, vascular parkinsonism

diseases.name: Essential tremor
diseases.inv: Clinical; check TSH and drug causes.

flags.text: Head injury with worsening drowsiness or confusion: emergency CT and neurosurgical review
Head injury with a lucid interval then deterioration: possible extradural haematoma, emergency
Signs of skull base or depressed fracture after head injury: urgent CT and neurosurgical review
Head injury in a patient on blood thinners: needs urgent CT even if well
Reduced alertness: check airway, glucose, GCS and pupils now
Infant with bulging fontanelle and sunsetting eyes: possible hydrocephalus, urgent
Open spinal swelling in a newborn: keep covered and moist, urgent neurosurgical review
